cc:Work.dc:description: Native-unit ecological estimates with common time axis, separate y-scales and no national quota. Dashed line marks 10 December 2023 only. Material values after 2019 excluded because projected inputs enter. Carbon accounts use preliminary accessed GCB workbook.
